tour.title: Project Overview
tour.description: Start with the project README, architecture docs, and pyproject.toml to understand DeerFlow's purpose as a super agent harness built on FastAPI + LangGraph.

tour.title: API Gateway Entry Point
tour.description: The FastAPI application is created in app/gateway/app.py. This is where all middleware (Auth, CSRF, CORS) and routers are wired together.

tour.title: Run Lifecycle — Services & SSE
tour.description: services.py contains start_run() and sse_consumer() — the core logic for launching agent runs and streaming results back via SSE. deps.py provides dependency injection.

tour.title: Lead Agent — The Core Orchestrator
tour.description: The Lead Agent is the main LangGraph agent that orchestrates conversations. See agent.py for make_lead_agent() and prompt.py for system prompt templates.

tour.title: Middleware Pipeline
tour.description: ~15 middleware components form the agent execution pipeline: memory, summarization, todo, title, loop detection, safety, sandbox audit, token usage, and more.

tour.title: Runtime Engine
tour.description: The runtime layer manages run execution: RunManager handles run lifecycle, StreamBridge manages SSE event distribution, Checkpointer persists conversation state, and worker.py executes agents.

tour.title: Model Providers
tour.description: Multi-model support through provider adapters: Claude (Anthropic), OpenAI Codex, DeepSeek, MiniMax, vLLM, and Mindie. Each provider handles API-specific details.

tour.title: Tools & Community Integrations
tour.description: Built-in tools (bash, file I/O, code editing, task management, search) plus community integrations (DDG search, sandbox execution, web scraping via Firecrawl, Jina AI).

tour.title: Persistence Layer
tour.description: SQLite-based data storage: thread metadata, run records, feedback, events journal, and user repository. Uses Alembic for migrations.

tour.title: Configuration System
tour.description: Comprehensive configuration management: app config, model config, agent config, MCP config, sandbox config, skills config, and path resolution utilities.

tour.title: IM Channel Integrations
tour.description: Multi-platform IM channel adapters: DingTalk, Discord, Feishu (Lark), Slack, Telegram, WeChat Official Account, and WeCom. ChannelManager orchestrates message routing.

tour.title: API Routers
tour.description: REST API endpoints for threads, runs, models, MCP, memory, skills, artifacts, uploads, agents, suggestions, channels, auth, and feedback.

tour.title: Tests & Quality
tour.description: Comprehensive test suite covering middleware, providers, tools, runtime lifecycle, auth, channels, and E2E scenarios. Test configuration in conftest.py.
